evidence.text: Harish–Chandra characters encode global single-particle representations. Their regulated Fourier transforms define static-patch spectral densities; character integrals compute quasicanonical thermodynamics and sphere determinants. Tools include covariant Pauli–Villars/heat-kernel regularization, Hubbard–Stratonovich transformation, contour deformation, Hurwitz zeta functions and residue sums.

sources.title: A string theoretic derivation of gibbons-hawking entropy

evidence.text: Compare parametric gravitational and open-string entropy counts using open–closed correspondence. Species entropy is counted through a binomial multiplicity and Stirling approximation; tachyon stabilization is tested by estimating the thermal mass induced by excited Chan–Paton species.

sources.title: Quantum de Sitter horizon entropy from quasicanonical bulk, edge, sphere and topological string partition functions

evidence.text: For massive symmetric spin s, locality motivates extending the TT eigenvalue sum from n≥s to n≥−1, admitting formal negative degeneracies. evidence.text: For matter-free dS3 gravity, the reviewed reduction proceeds from SL(2,C) Chern–Simons theory through a boundary WZNW model to Liouville theory. Asymptotically past-dS boundary conditions supply Hamiltonian-reduction constraints; the classical central charge is c=3ℓ/(2G).

sources.title: De Sitter Musings

evidence.text: Classical methods include constrained Cauchy evolution and a late-time Fefferman–Graham expansion. Boundary data comprise a three-metric g^(0) and a transverse-traceless tensor g^(3), with remaining expansion coefficients determined by these data.
